Singaporeans Eating Out More, Leading to Higher Calorie, Fat, and Sodium Intake

A survey indicates that as more Singaporeans opt to eat out, there is a growing concern over increased calorie, fat, and sodium intake. This trend is occurring alongside a movement towards a 'car-lite' lifestyle, with more residents choosing to forgo driving.
